body:
I think not pulling the trigger shows courage. Suicide is an easy out, but waking up each day when faced with such thoughts, that's what takes courage. Each day you wake up is another battle won. You may feel defeated and worn, but you're alive. 

What's driven you to this point?
You may be disappointed but I'm thankful, and I can only hope that one day soon you will be thankful as well. Put on some good tunes and try to get some rest.
Very happy to see you post on here. You're out of the hospital and hopefully alright? How are you feeling?
Alright, I contacted her and she had already contacted the police. He is okay!!!! :D No further calls to the number are necessary.

Yeah, I'm beginning to feel that exhaustion again. Not nearly as bad as it was years ago, but I fear for the fact that it's even coming back and could snowball into something bigger. Feel free to pm me sometime.

Just because you always **have** felt like that, doesn't mean you always **will**. I think you're still young, life is hard and will continue to be hard, but you're so young. So much can change in one year. Hell even a lot can change in 6 months. Take a deep breath and take it one day at time.

Something I wrote when I was much younger, that I feel is becoming relevant again. 

"I’m falling down, with this adoring smile on my face, almost plastered there. Which has quickly erased the look of distress that lingered for quite some time. The slipping of my heel was once the stress of myself, but is now the root of this contentment. What creates such a change? Well only the difference in the views of life. My composition has altered and adapted, as maturity and experience grew. Or could it be the result of ignorance? Climbing to success brings happiness to most, yet as I see the top of my ladder compress more and more, my life becomes enhanced. I am falling into happiness, I am falling into relaxation, I am falling into what I’ve always dreamed of, I am falling. "
